title: Doty's alien crystal that showed the crucifixion

tellings.quote: Now Richard Dodie tells the story. The most amazing thing he ever saw in the military. It was a crystal.

plain: A former military man named Richard Doty is said to have seen an alien crystal that showed the crucifixion of Jesus. He calls it the most amazing thing he ever saw in the military. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron passes the story on to Michels: "Richard Doty tells the story. The most amazing thing he ever saw in the military. It was a crystal."
